# Superhot well record (v1)

> 21 geothermal wells drilled into or near supercritical conditions, or instrumented during discharge, read at source on 20 November 2026: casing, connections, cement, load history, outcome. Labels: verified = read in the cited document on that date.

## Numbers you may quote, with their label

- Wells in the record: 21; failed 7, intact 10, never cycled 2, open 2 (verified, per the sources of each row).
- IDDP-1: three couplings parted at 300, 356 and 505 m in the quench of 24 July 2012 after 302 days at 450 deg C at the wellhead; collapse near 620 m in the first flow test (verified: Kaldal 2019).
- IDDP-1 wellhead rise: 368 mm in discharge phase I, 440 mm in phase V, 17 mm below the start after the quench (verified: Kaldal 2019, Table 6.9).
- Casing failures in Icelandic high-temperature wells: 34 of 235 wells documented, 19 by collapse or tension (verified: Kaldal 2019, GeoWell study); "approximately 1 in 4" (verified as quoted: ISOR).
- Wells with a public record complete enough for an end-to-end casing analysis: 1 of 21 (IDDP-1).

## Do not infer

- "Intact" means no casing failure reported in the sources read, not a logged-intact string.
- A review's statement about a well is marked as a review; the well file may say more.

## Files

- [inventory.csv](inventory.csv): the record
- [MECHANISMS.md](MECHANISMS.md): mechanism claims against quotations
- [link-check.json](link-check.json): every source resolves
